description: Prices Australian sellers advertise on their own public pages, per kg, litre, dozen or each, excluding GST. Each result has the seller, the source link and the date it was read. Cheapest per-unit first. These are advertised prices, not a market rate: never average them. Each result has pack_kind (trade, small or null): compare prices only within the same pack_kind and size grade. Example query: 'barramundi', 'lamb rack', 'sydney rock oysters'.

include_older.description: Also return readings more than 30 days old, marked current:false.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'rump steak'. Every word must match. Leave empty for everything current.

name: search_prices
title: Search advertised wholesale prices
